title: Judge Result Contract
description: v0.0.2. The authoritative machine-level result object every evaluation run must produce as its final non-empty output line (strict JSON). Only 'verdict' has contractual authority; all other fields are evidence-only and preserved in the transcript without effect on aggregation, resolution, or remedy. A run whose final line does not conform is an UNRESOLVED run. See spec/adjudication.md.

verdict.description: The binding projection. PASS/FAIL judge the requirement; UNRESOLVED records that this run could not establish it.

confidence.description: EVIDENCE-ONLY. Attribution and calibration research. Zero contractual authority.

rationale.description: EVIDENCE-ONLY. Short justification citing admissible evidence.
